title: Sr. AI Developer Engineer
description:
**About the Role**  
We are looking for a Senior AI Developer Engineer with strong hands\-on experience in AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent automation. The ideal candidate should be proficient in Python and experienced in building secure, scalable, production\-grade enterprise AI solutions using modern AI frameworks and cloud platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop enterprise\-grade AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Build LLM applications using RAG, prompt and context engineering, embeddings, semantic search, evaluations, and guardrails.
* Develop AI orchestration workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or comparable technologies.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise platforms, REST APIs, databases, identity systems, MCP, and workflow automation.
* Design distributed, cloud\-native, API\-driven, and data\-intensive applications on Azure and/or AWS.
* Implement scalable solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices.
* Collaborate with architecture, cloud, security, operations, product, and business teams to deliver reliable and secure AI applications.

**Required Skills**

* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI, ML, Generative AI, or intelligent automation.
* Strong proficiency in **Python**; C\#, Java, TypeScript, or JavaScript is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, semantic search, evaluations, and guardrails.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as **Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock**.
* Hands\-on experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as **Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI**.
* Experience with relational, NoSQL, and vector databases, including SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Search or comparable vector technologies.
* Strong understanding of Azure and/or AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD, monitoring, and secure software delivery.
* Experience with REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, enterprise identity, tool/function calling, MCP, and workflow automation.
* Proven experience delivering secure, scalable, production\-grade enterprise applications and collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Shopify/Webflow Developer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled and creative Shopify / Webflow Developer with 1–2 years of hands\-onexperience to join our development team. The ideal candidate should have experience building, customizing, and maintaining responsive e\-commerce and business websites using Shopify and Webflow.

The candidate will work closely with designers, project managers, and other developers to deliver high\-quality, user\-friendly, responsive, and performance\-oriented websites.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, customize, and maintain websites using Shopify and Webflow.
* Customize Shopify themes, templates, sections, and layouts according to project requirements.
* Develop responsive and visually appealing websites using Webflow.
* Convert Figma/PSD designs into responsive Shopify/Webflow websites.
* Work with Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for theme customization.
* Configure Shopify stores, products, collections, navigation, and basic store settings.
* Integrate third\-party apps, plugins, APIs, and other required tools.
* Troubleshoot and resolve website, layout, functionality, and compatibility issues.
* Optimize websites for speed, responsiveness, SEO, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Ensure websites are responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure accurate implementation of designs.
* Work with project managers and team members to understand requirements and deliver projects within timelines.
* Perform website testing, debugging, and quality checks before deployment.
* Maintain and update existing Shopify and Webflow websites as required.
* Stay updated with the latest Shopify, Webflow, e\-commerce, and web development trends.

**Required Skills**

* 1–2 years of professional experience in Shopify and/or Webflow development.
* Good hands\-on experience with Shopify theme customization.
* Basic to good knowledge of Shopify.
* Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
* Hands\-on experience with Webflow CMS and responsive website development.
* Experience converting Figma/PSD designs into functional websites.
* Good understanding of responsive design principles.
* Knowledge of website performance optimization and basic SEO.
* Experience with Shopify apps, integrations, and third\-party tools.
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Understanding of cross\-browser and cross\-device compatibility.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
